purpose: determine whether three fictitious sector packages can be delivered with acceptable quality and provisionally sustainable fulfillment cost before any demand test

simulations.fictional_context: salão de bairro com agenda por WhatsApp; no name, location, customer or real promotion
required_output: 4-theme outline for the next monthly cycle

simulations.fictional_context: local takeaway business with evening demand; no name, location, menu price or real promotion
required_output: 4-theme outline for the next monthly cycle

simulations.fictional_context: small local apparel store; no name, location, inventory, discount or real promotion
required_output: 4-theme outline for the next monthly cycle

fields.method: provider usage record attributable to this dry run; if unavailable mark inconclusive
time five scripted questions: tone change, calendar clarification, one rewrite, delivery issue and cancellation guidance
owner-defined opportunity-cost input fixed before execution
email/storage/runtime directly attributable to one delivery; unknown remains null

fields.formula: generation_variable_cost_brl + delivery_overhead_brl + ((first_review_minutes + rework_minutes + second_review_minutes + support_estimate_minutes) / 60 * labor_rate_brl_hour)

measurement_record_per_simulation.missing_value_rule: any required null remaining after the dry run makes sustainability inconclusive; it must not be replaced by zero

weighted_total_100.objective_check: exactly 12 posts, 4 messages, 30 populated calendar days and 4 next-cycle themes
at least 10 of 12 posts and all 4 messages contain a genuine sector action or situation, without invented business facts
every item states a clear customer-facing action or publishing purpose
no unresolved placeholder, broken sentence or unexplained jargon
no guarantee, fabricated testimonial, fabricated discount, legal/medical claim, personal data or unsupported fact
no exact duplicated post body within a package; next-cycle themes do not repeat the 12 current themes

critical_failures: fabricated testimonial, price, discount, inventory or local fact
instructions to publish or contact customers

acceptance.reviewer_rule: two review passes; the final pass cannot reuse the first reviewer's score without independent inspection

sustainability_pre_registration.nature: management hypothesis, not an industry benchmark
success: each measured total_fulfillment_cost_brl is at or below 49.25
each first_review_minutes + rework_minutes is at or below 75
each support_estimate_minutes is at or below 30
all required cost fields are known
failure: two or more packages score below 85
two or more packages exceed any cost or time ceiling
inconclusive: any required cost input remains unknown
exactly one package misses a noncritical quality, cost or time threshold
execution environment or rubric changes after the first simulation
sustainability_pre_registration.margin_caveat: passing this operational ceiling does not prove profit; taxes, payment fees, refunds, acquisition cost and real support must be measured before a margin claim

interest_test_after_simulation_only.primary_metric: price-qualified intent clicks divided by qualified unique views

success.rule: at least 200 qualified unique views and at least 10 price-qualified intent clicks

failure.rule: at least 200 qualified unique views and at most 5 price-qualified intent clicks

inconclusive: 6 to 9 price-qualified intent clicks after 200 qualified unique views
fewer than 200 qualified unique views after 28 days
measurement loss, duplicated traffic or material audience mismatch
any checkout, payment path or personal-data requirement becomes reachable
interpretation_limits: an intent click is not a purchase
this test cannot prove renewal or lifetime value
thresholds are pre-registered management criteria, not market benchmarks

decision_after_measurement.if_simulation_success: request separate authorization for the no-charge aggregate interest test
decision_after_measurement.if_simulation_failure: reject or redesign the delivery before any market exposure
decision_after_measurement.if_simulation_inconclusive: resolve missing cost or quality evidence; do not launch
